question: In Fall 2025, do 15-150 (Section W: Thursday, Tuesday, Sunday 14:30–15:45) and 15-451 (Section 2: Thursday, Sunday 14:30–15:45) conflict?
expected_answer: Yes — both courses share Thursday 14:30–15:45 and Sunday 14:30–15:45. A student cannot enroll in both these sections in the same semester.
